    bMRU3_Fault                 : BOOL;     (* MRU 3 discrepancy fault latch *)

    rColumnCenterDistance_Y     : REAL := 68.0;     (* Transverse distance between column centers [m] *)

    rFSE_Inertia_FS             : REAL;     (* Slack liquid second moment of free surface FS [m4] *)

    rAirHeaderNominalPressure   : REAL := 30.0;     (* Design nominal supply manifold pressure [bar] *)

    (* Timers & Diagnostic Execution Blocks *)

    tonEmergencyBlowingTimer    : TON;      (* Max duration watchdog for continuous emergency air discharge *)
    tonDegradedBlinkTimer       : TON;      (* Diagnostic flasher for degraded operational state *)
    tonWatchdogHeartbeat        : TON;      (* Controller internal execution cycle watchdog *)

    iCol                        : INT;

    rTempVar                    : REAL;
    rSafeCycleTime              : REAL;

(* === MAIN LOGIC IMPLEMENTATION === *)

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    rSafeCycleTime := 0.050; (* Fallback to 50ms nominal task timebase if out of bounds *)
ELSE
    rSafeCycleTime := rCycleTime_s;
END_IF;

tonWatchdogHeartbeat(IN := NOT tonWatchdogHeartbeat.Q, PT := T#500MS);

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   02. 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) MRU SENSOR FUSION & DISCREPANCY VOTING
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute absolute discrepancies between all 3 redundant MRUs *)
rRollDiff12 := ABS(rRollAngle_MRU1 - rRollAngle_MRU2);
rRollDiff23 := ABS(rRollAngle_MRU2 - rRollAngle_MRU3);
rRollDiff31 := ABS(rRollAngle_MRU3 - rRollAngle_MRU1);

rPitchDiff12 := ABS(rPitchAngle_MRU1 - rPitchAngle_MRU2);
rPitchDiff23 := ABS(rPitchAngle_MRU2 - rPitchAngle_MRU3);
rPitchDiff31 := ABS(rPitchAngle_MRU3 - rPitchAngle_MRU1);

(* Check for discrepancy threshold exceedances (0.65 deg persistence) *)
tonMRUDiscrepancyTimer(
    IN := (rRollDiff12 > 0.65) OR (rRollDiff23 > 0.65) OR (rRollDiff31 > 0.65) OR
          (rPitchDiff12 > 0.65) OR (rPitchDiff23 > 0.65) OR (rPitchDiff31 > 0.65),
    PT := T#250MS
);

(* Channel Disparity Fault Isolation via 2oo3 Parity Evaluation *)
IF tonMRUDiscrepancyTimer.Q THEN
    bMRU1_Fault := (rRollDiff12 > 0.65) AND (rRollDiff31 > 0.65);
    bMRU2_Fault := (rRollDiff12 > 0.65) AND (rRollDiff23 > 0.65);
    bMRU3_Fault := (rRollDiff23 > 0.65) AND (rRollDiff31 > 0.65);
ELSE
    IF bResetFaults THEN
        bMRU1_Fault := FALSE;
        bMRU2_Fault := FALSE;
        bMRU3_Fault := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iMRU_FaultCount := 0;
IF bMRU1_Fault THEN iMRU_FaultCount := iMRU_FaultCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bMRU2_Fault THEN iMRU_FaultCount := iMRU_FaultCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bMRU3_Fault THEN iMRU_FaultCount := iMRU_FaultCount + 1; END_IF;

(* Median Selection Voting for Roll, Pitch, and Rates *)

    (* Healthy 2oo3 Condition: Classic Median Filter Algorithm *)
    IF ((rRollAngle_MRU1 >= rRollAngle_MRU2) AND (rRollAngle_MRU1 <= rRollAngle_MRU3)) OR 
       ((rRollAngle_MRU1 <= rRollAngle_MRU2) AND (rRollAngle_MRU1 >= rRollAngle_MRU3)) THEN
        rVotedRollAngle := rRollAngle_MRU1;
        rVotedRollRate := rRollRate_MRU1;
    ELSIF ((rRollAngle_MRU2 >= rRollAngle_MRU1) AND (rRollAngle_MRU2 <= rRollAngle_MRU3)) OR 
          ((rRollAngle_MRU2 <= rRollAngle_MRU1) AND (rRollAngle_MRU2 >= rRollAngle_MRU3)) THEN
        rVotedRollAngle := rRollAngle_MRU2;
        rVotedRollRate := rRollRate_MRU2;
    ELSE
        rVotedRollAngle := rRollAngle_MRU3;
        rVotedRollRate := rRollRate_MRU3;
    END_IF;

    IF ((rPitchAngle_MRU1 >= rPitchAngle_MRU2) AND (rPitchAngle_MRU1 <= rPitchAngle_MRU3)) OR 
       ((rPitchAngle_MRU1 <= rPitchAngle_MRU2) AND (rPitchAngle_MRU1 >= rPitchAngle_MRU3)) THEN
        rVotedPitchAngle := rPitchAngle_MRU1;
        rVotedPitchRate := rPitchRate_MRU1;
    ELSIF ((rPitchAngle_MRU2 >= rPitchAngle_MRU1) AND (rPitchAngle_MRU2 <= rPitchAngle_MRU3)) OR 
          ((rPitchAngle_MRU2 <= rPitchAngle_MRU1) AND (rPitchAngle_MRU2 >= rPitchAngle_MRU3)) THEN
        rVotedPitchAngle := rPitchAngle_MRU2;
        rVotedPitchRate := rPitchRate_MRU2;
    ELSE
        rVotedPitchAngle := rPitchAngle_MRU3;
        rVotedPitchRate := rPitchRate_MRU3;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bMRU1_Fault AND (NOT bMRU2_Fault) AND (NOT bMRU3_Fault) THEN
    (* Channel 1 Degraded: Average MRU2 and MRU3 *)
    rVotedRollAngle := (rRollAngle_MRU2 + rRollAngle_MRU3) * 0.5;
    rVotedPitchAngle := (rPitchAngle_MRU2 + rPitchAngle_MRU3) * 0.5;
    rVotedRollRate := (rRollRate_MRU2 + rRollRate_MRU3) * 0.5;
    rVotedPitchRate := (rPitchRate_MRU2 + rPitchRate_MRU3) * 0.5;
ELSIF bMRU2_Fault AND (NOT bMRU1_Fault) AND (NOT bMRU3_Fault) THEN
    (* Channel 2 Degraded: Average MRU1 and MRU3 *)
    rVotedRollAngle := (rRollAngle_MRU1 + rRollAngle_MRU3) * 0.5;
    rVotedPitchAngle := (rPitchAngle_MRU1 + rPitchAngle_MRU3) * 0.5;
    rVotedRollRate := (rRollRate_MRU1 + rRollRate_MRU3) * 0.5;
    rVotedPitchRate := (rPitchRate_MRU1 + rPitchRate_MRU3) * 0.5;
ELSIF bMRU3_Fault AND (NOT bMRU1_Fault) AND (NOT bMRU2_Fault) THEN
    (* Channel 3 Degraded: Average MRU1 and MRU2 *)
    rVotedRollAngle := (rRollAngle_MRU1 + rRollAngle_MRU2) * 0.5;
    rVotedPitchAngle := (rPitchAngle_MRU1 + rPitchAngle_MRU2) * 0.5;
    rVotedRollRate := (rRollRate_MRU1 + rRollRate_MRU2) * 0.5;
    rVotedPitchRate := (rPitchRate_MRU1 + rPitchRate_MRU2) * 0.5;
ELSE
    (* Multiple MRU Failure: Hold last filtered values and trip alarm *)
    rVotedRollAngle := rFilteredRoll;
    rVotedPitchAngle := rFilteredPitch;
    rVotedRollRate := 0.0;
    rVotedPitchRate := 0.0;

rTankMass_AP := rTankLevel_AP * rTankCrossSectionArea * rSeawaterSpecificGravity;
rTankMass_AS := rTankLevel_AS * rTankCrossSectionArea * rSeawaterSpecificGravity;
rTotalBallastMass := rTankMass_FP + rTankMass_FS + rTankMass_AP + rTankMass_AS;

(* Cumulative Platform Displacement Mass and Underwater Volume *)
rCurrentPlatformDisplacement := rLightshipWeight + rTotalBallastMass;
IF rSeawaterSpecificGravity > 0.5 THEN
    rDisplacedVolume := rCurrentPlatformDisplacement / rSeawaterSpecificGravity;
ELSE
    rDisplacedVolume := rCurrentPlatformDisplacement / 1.025;
END_IF;

(* Vertical Center of Gravity (KG) Cumulative Moments *)
rTotalStaticMoment_Z := (rLightshipWeight * rLightshipKG) +
                        (rTankMass_FP * (rTankBaseKG + (rTankLevel_FP * 0.5))) +
                        (rTankMass_FS * (rTankBaseKG + (rTankLevel_FS * 0.5))) +
                        (rTankMass_AP * (rTankBaseKG + (rTankLevel_AP * 0.5))) +
                        (rTankMass_AS * (rTankBaseKG + (rTankLevel_AS * 0.5)));

IF rCurrentPlatformDisplacement > 1000.0 THEN
    rKG_Current := rTotalStaticMoment_Z / rCurrentPlatformDisplacement;
ELSE
    rKG_Current := rLightshipKG;
END_IF;

(* Height of Center of Buoyancy (KB) as Function of Operating Draft *)
IF rPlatformDraft > 6.0 THEN
    (* Platform pontoons are completely submerged; columns penetrate water surface *)
    rKB_Current := ((rPontoonDisplacementKeel * rPontoonKB) + 
                   (rTotalWaterplaneArea * (rPlatformDraft - 6.0) * rSeawaterSpecificGravity * (6.0 + ((rPlatformDraft - 6.0) * 0.5)))) / 
                   rCurrentPlatformDisplacement;
ELSE
    rKB_Current := rPontoonKB * (rPlatformDraft / 6.0);
END_IF;

(* Waterplane Moments of Inertia at Column Waterline (Parallel Axis Theorem) *)
(* I_T = 4 * [ (L * B^3 / 12) + A_col * y_c^2 ], where y_c = 34.0 m *)
rWaterplaneInertia_T := 4.0 * ((rColumnWidth_X * rColumnWidth_Y * rColumnWidth_Y * rColumnWidth_Y / 12.0) + 
                               (rColumnSectionArea * (rColumnCenterDistance_Y * 0.5) * (rColumnCenterDistance_Y * 0.5)));

(* I_L = 4 * [ (B * L^3 / 12) + A_col * x_c^2 ], where x_c = 34.0 m *)
rWaterplaneInertia_L := 4.0 * ((rColumnWidth_Y * rColumnWidth_X * rColumnWidth_X * rColumnWidth_X / 12.0) + 
                               (rColumnSectionArea * (rColumnCenterDistance_X * 0.5) * (rColumnCenterDistance_X * 0.5)));

(* Metacentric Radii: BM = I / Displaced_Volume *)
IF rDisplacedVolume > 100.0 THEN
    rBM_Transverse := rWaterplaneInertia_T / rDisplacedVolume;
    rBM_Longitudinal := rWaterplaneInertia_L / rDisplacedVolume;
ELSE
    rBM_Transverse := 0.0;
    rBM_Longitudinal := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Free Surface Moment of Slack Ballast Tanks (FSE virtual rise of G) *)
(* Tank breadth b = 9.22m, length l = 9.22m (approx sqrt(85m2)) -> i_tank = 9.22^4 / 12 = 602.0 m4 *)
IF (rTankLevel_FP > 0.4) AND (rTankLevel_FP < (rTankMaxHeight - 0.4)) THEN
    rFSE_Inertia_FP := 602.0;
ELSE
    rFSE_Inertia_FP := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF (rTankLevel_FS > 0.4) AND (rTankLevel_FS < (rTankMaxHeight - 0.4)) THEN
    rFSE_Inertia_FS := 602.0;
ELSE
    rFSE_Inertia_FS := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF (rTankLevel_AP > 0.4) AND (rTankLevel_AP < (rTankMaxHeight - 0.4)) THEN
    rFSE_Inertia_AP := 602.0;
ELSE
    rFSE_Inertia_AP := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF (rTankLevel_AS > 0.4) AND (rTankLevel_AS < (rTankMaxHeight - 0.4)) THEN
    rFSE_Inertia_AS := 602.0;
ELSE
    rFSE_Inertia_AS := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rCurrentPlatformDisplacement > 1000.0 THEN
    rFreeSurfaceCorrection_GG1 := (rSeawaterSpecificGravity * (rFSE_Inertia_FP + rFSE_Inertia_FS + rFSE_Inertia_AP + rFSE_Inertia_AS)) / 
                                   rCurrentPlatformDisplacement;
ELSE
    rFreeSurfaceCorrection_GG1 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* True Dynamic Metacentric Heights (GM_T and GM_L) *)
rComputedGM_Transverse := rKB_Current + rBM_Transverse - rKG_Current - rFreeSurfaceCorrection_GG1;
rComputedGM_Longitudinal := rKB_Current + rBM_Longitudinal - rKG_Current - (rFreeSurfaceCorrection_GG1 * 0.95);

(* Total Instantaneous Blowing Air Mass Flow Rate Summation *)
rTotalAirConsumptionRate := rAirBlowingFlow_FP + rAirBlowingFlow_FS + rAirBlowingFlow_AP + rAirBlowingFlow_AS;

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   04. STATE-SPACE DYNAMICS & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL GAIN CALCULATION
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* State Vector Definition (Error coordinates relative to trim targets):
   x1: Transverse heel error e_phi [rad] = (rFilteredRoll - rTargetRoll) * PI / 180.0
   x2: Transverse roll rate dphi_dt [rad/s] = rVotedRollRate * PI / 180.0
   x3: Longitudinal trim error e_theta [rad] = (rFilteredPitch - rTargetPitch) * PI / 180.0
   x4: Longitudinal pitch rate dtheta_dt [rad/s] = rVotedPitchRate * PI / 180.0
   x5: Draft displacement error e_z [m] = rPlatformDraft - rTargetDraft
   x6: Dynamic Metacentric Height deficit [m] = rMinMetacentricHeight_GM - rComputedGM_Transverse
*)
arrStateVector[1] := (rFilteredRoll - rTargetRoll) * 0.01745329;
arrStateVector[2] := rVotedRollRate * 0.01745329;
arrStateVector[3] := (rFilteredPitch - rTargetPitch) * 0.01745329;
arrStateVector[4] := rVotedPitchRate * 0.01745329;
arrStateVector[5] := rPlatformDraft - rTargetDraft;
arrStateVector[6] := rMinMetacentricHeight_GM - rComputedGM_Transverse;

(* Hydrodynamic State-Space Transition Matrix Ad = I + Ac * dt (Pre-linearized around operating draft 21m) *)
(* Row 1: Roll Angle integration *)
arrAd[1, 1] := 1.0;
arrAd[1, 2] := rSafeCycleTime;
arrAd[1, 3] := 0.0;
arrAd[1, 4] := 0.0;
arrAd[1, 5] := 0.0;
arrAd[1, 6] := 0.0;

(* Row 2: Roll Angular Acceleration (Damped Pendulum: w_n^2 = g*GM/r_xx^2, damping b_roll = 0.08) *)
arrAd[2, 1] := -1.85 * rSafeCycleTime * (rComputedGM_Transverse / 2.5);
arrAd[2, 2] := 1.0 - (0.085 * rSafeCycleTime);
arrAd[2, 3] := 0.0;
arrAd[2, 4] := 0.0;
arrAd[2, 5] := 0.0;
arrAd[2, 6] := 0.0;

(* Row 3: Pitch Angle integration *)
arrAd[3, 1] := 0.0;
arrAd[3, 2] := 0.0;
arrAd[3, 3] := 1.0;
arrAd[3, 4] := rSafeCycleTime;
arrAd[3, 5] := 0.0;
arrAd[3, 6] := 0.0;

(* Row 4: Pitch Angular Acceleration (w_n^2 = g*GM_L/r_yy^2, damping b_pitch = 0.09) *)
arrAd[4, 1] := 0.0;
arrAd[4, 2] := 0.0;
arrAd[4, 3] := -1.65 * rSafeCycleTime * (rComputedGM_Longitudinal / 3.0);
arrAd[4, 4] := 1.0 - (0.092 * rSafeCycleTime);
arrAd[4, 5] := 0.0;
arrAd[4, 6] := 0.0;

(* Row 5: Heave/Draft Restoring Response (Restoring stiffness = rho*g*Awp / M) *)
arrAd[5, 1] := 0.0;
arrAd[5, 2] := 0.0;
arrAd[5, 3] := 0.0;
arrAd[5, 4] := 0.0;
arrAd[5, 5] := 1.0 - (0.125 * rSafeCycleTime);
arrAd[5, 6] := 0.0;

(* Row 6: Metacentric Height variation dynamics *)
arrAd[6, 1] := 0.0;
arrAd[6, 2] := 0.0;
arrAd[6, 3] := 0.0;
arrAd[6, 4] := 0.0;
arrAd[6, 5] := 0.052 * rSafeCycleTime;
arrAd[6, 6] := 1.0 - (0.050 * rSafeCycleTime);

(* Actuator Input Coupling Matrix Bd (6x4) for 4 corner column ballast tanks:
   u1 = FP blowing flow [m3/s], u2 = FS blowing flow [m3/s], 
   u3 = AP blowing flow [m3/s], u4 = AS blowing flow [m3/s]
   Moment arms: x_arm = 34.0 m, y_arm = 34.0 m
   Blowing causes de-ballasting (loss of mass -> upward buoyant lift at quadrant)
   FP lift -> induces +roll (starboard list) and -pitch (aft trim)
   FS lift -> induces -roll (port list) and -pitch (aft trim)
   AP lift -> induces +roll (starboard list) and +pitch (forward trim)
   AS lift -> induces -roll (port list) and +pitch (forward trim)
*)
(* Row 1: Roll influence (dt * 0.0) *)
arrBd[1, 1] := 0.0;   arrBd[1, 2] := 0.0;   arrBd[1, 3] := 0.0;   arrBd[1, 4] := 0.0;

(* Row 2: Roll Angular Velocity Acceleration Bd[2, :] *)
arrBd[2, 1] := 0.0034 * rSafeCycleTime;   (* FP blowing causes +roll *)
arrBd[2, 2] := -0.0034 * rSafeCycleTime;  (* FS blowing causes -roll *)
arrBd[2, 3] := 0.0034 * rSafeCycleTime;   (* AP blowing causes +roll *)
arrBd[2, 4] := -0.0034 * rSafeCycleTime;  (* AS blowing causes -roll *)

(* Row 3: Pitch influence (dt * 0.0) *)
arrBd[3, 1] := 0.0;   arrBd[3, 2] := 0.0;   arrBd[3, 3] := 0.0;   arrBd[3, 4] := 0.0;

(* Row 4: Pitch Angular Velocity Acceleration Bd[4, :] *)
arrBd[4, 1] := -0.0031 * rSafeCycleTime;  (* FP blowing causes -pitch *)
arrBd[4, 2] := -0.0031 * rSafeCycleTime;  (* FS blowing causes -pitch *)
arrBd[4, 3] := 0.0031 * rSafeCycleTime;   (* AP blowing causes +pitch *)
arrBd[4, 4] := 0.0031 * rSafeCycleTime;   (* AS blowing causes +pitch *)

(* Row 5: Heave draft displacement influence (all blowing decreases draft) *)
arrBd[5, 1] := -0.0016 * rSafeCycleTime;
arrBd[5, 2] := -0.0016 * rSafeCycleTime;
arrBd[5, 3] := -0.0016 * rSafeCycleTime;
arrBd[5, 4] := -0.0016 * rSafeCycleTime;

(* Row 6: Metacentric height GM modification influence *)
arrBd[6, 1] := 0.0008 * rSafeCycleTime;
arrBd[6, 2] := 0.0008 * rSafeCycleTime;
arrBd[6, 3] := 0.0008 * rSafeCycleTime;
arrBd[6, 4] := 0.0008 * rSafeCycleTime;

(* Output Observation Matrix Cd (4x6) and Feedthrough Dd (4x4) *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        arrCd[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        arrDd[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;
arrCd[1, 1] := 57.29578; (* Heel [deg] *)
arrCd[2, 3] := 57.29578; (* Trim [deg] *)
arrCd[3, 5] := 1.0;      (* Draft [m] *)
arrCd[4, 6] := 1.0;      (* GM [m] *)

(* Pre-calculated Quadratic Cost Horizon Optimal Gain K_mpc (4x6) Derived from:
   State Penalty Q = diag([120.0, 35.0, 110.0, 32.0, 45.0, 85.0])
   Actuator Penalty R = diag([2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5])
   K_mpc = (Bd^T * Q * Bd + R)^(-1) * Bd^T * Q * Ad
*)
arrK_mpc[1, 1] :=  14.25;  arrK_mpc[1, 2] :=  4.85;  arrK_mpc[1, 3] := -13.80;  arrK_mpc[1, 4] := -4.60;  arrK_mpc[1, 5] := -8.50;  arrK_mpc[1, 6] :=  12.20;
arrK_mpc[2, 1] := -14.25;  arrK_mpc[2, 2] := -4.85;  arrK_mpc[2, 3] := -13.80;  arrK_mpc[2, 4] := -4.60;  arrK_mpc[2, 5] := -8.50;  arrK_mpc[2, 6] :=  12.20;
arrK_mpc[3, 1] :=  14.25;  arrK_mpc[3, 2] :=  4.85;  arrK_mpc[3, 3] :=  13.80;  arrK_mpc[3, 4] :=  4.60;  arrK_mpc[3, 5] := -8.50;  arrK_mpc[3, 6] :=  12.20;
arrK_mpc[4, 1] := -14.25;  arrK_mpc[4, 2] := -4.85;  arrK_mpc[4, 3] :=  13.80;  arrK_mpc[4, 4] :=  4.60;  arrK_mpc[4, 5] := -8.50;  arrK_mpc[4, 6] :=  12.20;

(* Matrix-Vector Multiplication: u = - K_mpc * x *)
FOR iRow := 1 TO 4 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (arrK_mpc[iRow, iCol] * arrStateVector[iCol]);
    END_FOR;
    arrControlDemands[iRow] := -rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   05. COMPREHENSIVE INDUSTRIAL ALARM TREE & DIAGNOSTIC WORD ENCODING
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
wAlarmWord := 16#0000;

(* Bit 00: Critical Low Transverse GM Stability Margin (< Minimum Threshold) *)
IF rComputedGM_Transverse < rMinMetacentricHeight_GM THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0001;
END_IF;

(* Bit 01: Severe Transverse Platform Heel Exceedance (> 3.5 deg) *)
IF ABS(rFilteredRoll) > rMaxAllowableRoll THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0002;
END_IF;

(* Bit 02: Severe Longitudinal Platform Trim Exceedance (> 3.0 deg) *)
IF ABS(rFilteredPitch) > rMaxAllowablePitch THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0004;
END_IF;

(* Bit 03: Compressed Air Header Low Supply Pressure (< 18.0 bar) *)
IF rAirHeaderPressure < rAirHeaderMinPressure THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0008;
END_IF;

(* Bit 04: MRU 2oo3 Discrepancy Failure Latched (Sensor divergence) *)
IF iMRU_FaultCount > 0 THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0010;
END_IF;

(* Bit 05: Excessive Free Surface Effect Virtual Rise (GG1 > 0.85 m) *)
IF rFreeSurfaceCorrection_GG1 > 0.85 THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0020;
END_IF;

(* Bit 06: Forward-Port Tank High-High Sounding Level (> 95%) *)
IF rTankLevel_FP > (rTankMaxHeight * 0.95) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0040;
END_IF;

(* Bit 07: Forward-Starboard Tank High-High Sounding Level (> 95%) *)
IF rTankLevel_FS > (rTankMaxHeight * 0.95) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0080;
END_IF;

(* Bit 08: Aft-Port Tank High-High Sounding Level (> 95%) *)
IF rTankLevel_AP > (rTankMaxHeight * 0.95) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0100;
END_IF;

(* Bit 09: Aft-Starboard Tank High-High Sounding Level (> 95%) *)
IF rTankLevel_AS > (rTankMaxHeight * 0.95) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0200;
END_IF;

(* Bit 10: Low-Low Sounding Level Dry Blowing Protection (< 0.20 m) *)
IF (rTankLevel_FP < 0.20) OR (rTankLevel_FS < 0.20) OR (rTankLevel_AP < 0.20) OR (rTankLevel_AS < 0.20) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0400;
END_IF;

(* Bit 11: Emergency Air Blowing Active Status *)
IF bEmergencyBlowingActive THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#0800;
END_IF;

(* Bit 12: Degradation Fallback Mode Engaged *)
IF bDegradedModeActive THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#1000;
END_IF;

(* Bit 13: Attitude Extreme Dynamic Limit Exceeded (> 6.0 deg Trip) *)
IF (ABS(rFilteredRoll) > rCriticalTripAngle) OR (ABS(rFilteredPitch) > rCriticalTripAngle) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#2000;
END_IF;

(* Bit 14: Dual/Triple MRU Failure Trip *)
IF iMRU_FaultCount >= 2 THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#4000;
END_IF;

(* Bit 15: General Supervisory Trip Lockout *)
IF (iState = 99) THEN
    wAlarmWord := wAlarmWord OR 16#8000;
END_IF;

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   06. DETERMINISTIC MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE) WITH GRACEFUL DEGRADATION
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Air Supply Manifold Pressure Stabilization Monitoring *)
tonAirSupplyStabilize(IN := (rAirHeaderPressure >= rAirHeaderMinPressure), PT := T#2S);

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE_INIT: System Hydrostatic Bootstrapping & Sanity Checks *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bAutoTrimActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyBlowingActive := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Close all pneumatic injection, vent, and seawater dump valves *)
        rAirSupplyValve_FP := 0.0;
        rAirSupplyValve_FS := 0.0;
        rAirSupplyValve_AP := 0.0;
        rAirSupplyValve_AS := 0.0;
        rDumpValve_FP := 0.0;
        rDumpValve_FS := 0.0;
        rDumpValve_AP := 0.0;
        rDumpValve_AS := 0.0;
        rVentValve_FP := 0.0;
        rVentValve_FS := 0.0;
        rVentValve_AP := 0.0;
        rVentValve_AS := 0.0;

        IF bEnable AND tonAirSupplyStabilize.Q AND (iMRU_FaultCount < 2) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to STANDBY *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_STANDBY: Tanks Isolated, Atmospheric Vent Closed, Monitoring Attitude *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bAutoTrimActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyBlowingActive := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive := (iMRU_FaultCount = 1);

        (* Maintain valve closure in hydrostatic lock *)
        rAirSupplyValve_FP := 0.0;  rAirSupplyValve_FS := 0.0;
        rAirSupplyValve_AP := 0.0;  rAirSupplyValve_AS := 0.0;
        rDumpValve_FP := 0.0;       rDumpValve_FS := 0.0;
        rDumpValve_AP := 0.0;       rDumpValve_AS := 0.0;
        rVentValve_FP := 0.0;       rVentValve_FS := 0.0;
        rVentValve_AP := 0.0;       rVentValve_AS := 0.0;

        (* State Transitions *)
        IF bEmergencyDeBallastCmd OR ((wAlarmWord AND 16#2000) <> 0) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Direct Jump to EMERGENCY DEBALLAST *)
        ELSIF NOT bEnable OR (rAirHeaderPressure < (rAirHeaderMinPressure - 2.0)) THEN
            iState := 0;
        ELSIF bAutoTrimEnable THEN
            IF iMRU_FaultCount = 0 THEN
                iState := 20; (* Nominal Dynamic MPC Trim *)
            ELSIF iMRU_FaultCount = 1 THEN
                iState := 50; (* Degraded Trim with single failed MRU *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_DYNAMIC_TRIM_MPC: Active Multivariable Multitank Dynamic Trim & GM Control *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bAutoTrimActive := TRUE;
        bEmergencyBlowingActive := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;

        (* Map MPC Control Vector u to Pneumatic Injection vs. Atmospheric Vent & Dump Valves
           If u[i] > 0: Tank requires de-ballasting (Air injection valve opens, dump valve opens, vent shut)
           If u[i] < 0: Tank requires ballasting (Vent valve opens, sea dump valve opens for gravity flood)
        *)
        (* Quadrant 1: Forward-Port (FP) Tank Modulation *)
        IF arrControlDemands[1] > 0.5 THEN
            rAirSupplyValve_FP := MIN(100.0, arrControlDemands[1] * 2.5);
            rDumpValve_FP := MIN(100.0, arrControlDemands[1] * 2.8);
            rVentValve_FP := 0.0;
        ELSIF arrControlDemands[1] < -0.5 THEN
            rAirSupplyValve_FP := 0.0;
            rDumpValve_FP := MIN(100.0, ABS(arrControlDemands[1]) * 2.0);
            rVentValve_FP := MIN(100.0, ABS(arrControlDemands[1]) * 2.5);
        ELSE
            rAirSupplyValve_FP := 0.0;
            rDumpValve_FP := 0.0;
            rVentValve_FP := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Quadrant 2: Forward-Starboard (FS) Tank Modulation *)
        IF arrControlDemands[2] > 0.5 THEN
            rAirSupplyValve_FS := MIN(100.0, arrControlDemands[2] * 2.5);
            rDumpValve_FS := MIN(100.0, arrControlDemands[2] * 2.8);
            rVentValve_FS := 0.0;
        ELSIF arrControlDemands[2] < -0.5 THEN
            rAirSupplyValve_FS := 0.0;
            rDumpValve_FS := MIN(100.0, ABS(arrControlDemands[2]) * 2.0);
            rVentValve_FS := MIN(100.0, ABS(arrControlDemands[2]) * 2.5);
        ELSE
            rAirSupplyValve_FS := 0.0;
            rDumpValve_FS := 0.0;
            rVentValve_FS := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Quadrant 3: Aft-Port (AP) Tank Modulation *)
        IF arrControlDemands[3] > 0.5 THEN
            rAirSupplyValve_AP := MIN(100.0, arrControlDemands[3] * 2.5);
            rDumpValve_AP := MIN(100.0, arrControlDemands[3] * 2.8);
            rVentValve_AP := 0.0;
        ELSIF arrControlDemands[3] < -0.5 THEN
            rAirSupplyValve_AP := 0.0;
            rDumpValve_AP := MIN(100.0, ABS(arrControlDemands[3]) * 2.0);
            rVentValve_AP := MIN(100.0, ABS(arrControlDemands[3]) * 2.5);
        ELSE
            rAirSupplyValve_AP := 0.0;
            rDumpValve_AP := 0.0;
            rVentValve_AP := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Quadrant 4: Aft-Starboard (AS) Tank Modulation *)
        IF arrControlDemands[4] > 0.5 THEN
            rAirSupplyValve_AS := MIN(100.0, arrControlDemands[4] * 2.5);
            rDumpValve_AS := MIN(100.0, arrControlDemands[4] * 2.8);
            rVentValve_AS := 0.0;
        ELSIF arrControlDemands[4] < -0.5 THEN
            rAirSupplyValve_AS := 0.0;
            rDumpValve_AS := MIN(100.0, ABS(arrControlDemands[4]) * 2.0);
            rVentValve_AS := MIN(100.0, ABS(arrControlDemands[4]) * 2.5);
        ELSE
            rAirSupplyValve_AS := 0.0;
            rDumpValve_AS := 0.0;
            rVentValve_AS := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Low-level liquid cutoff to prevent compressed air blowing through bottom sea dump *)
        IF rTankLevel_FP < 0.25 THEN rAirSupplyValve_FP := 0.0; END_IF;
        IF rTankLevel_FS < 0.25 THEN rAirSupplyValve_FS := 0.0; END_IF;
        IF rTankLevel_AP < 0.25 THEN rAirSupplyValve_AP := 0.0; END_IF;
        IF rTankLevel_AS < 0.25 THEN rAirSupplyValve_AS := 0.0; END_IF;

        (* State Transitions *)
        IF bEmergencyDeBallastCmd OR ((wAlarmWord AND 16#2000) <> 0) THEN
            iState := 40;
        ELSIF NOT bEnable OR NOT bAutoTrimEnable THEN
            iState := 10;
        ELSIF iMRU_FaultCount = 1 THEN
            iState := 50; (* Fallback to graceful degradation *)
        ELSIF iMRU_FaultCount >= 2 OR (rAirHeaderPressure < rAirHeaderMinPressure) THEN
            iState := 99; (* Trip lockout *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_DEBALLAST: Maximum Compressed Air Expulsion on All Tanks *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bAutoTrimActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyBlowingActive := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;

        (* Force open high-pressure blowing valves and sea dump overboard discharges *)
        rAirSupplyValve_FP := 100.0;
        rAirSupplyValve_FS := 100.0;
        rAirSupplyValve_AP := 100.0;
        rAirSupplyValve_AS := 100.0;

        rDumpValve_FP := 100.0;
        rDumpValve_FS := 100.0;
        rDumpValve_AP := 100.0;
        rDumpValve_AS := 100.0;

        (* Close all atmospheric tank vents to ensure full pneumatic pressure head *)
        rVentValve_FP := 0.0;
        rVentValve_FS := 0.0;
        rVentValve_AP := 0.0;
        rVentValve_AS := 0.0;

        (* Automatic protective dry-pipe isolation for individual empty tanks *)
        IF rTankLevel_FP < 0.15 THEN rAirSupplyValve_FP := 0.0; rDumpValve_FP := 0.0; END_IF;
        IF rTankLevel_FS < 0.15 THEN rAirSupplyValve_FS := 0.0; rDumpValve_FS := 0.0; END_IF;
        IF rTankLevel_AP < 0.15 THEN rAirSupplyValve_AP := 0.0; rDumpValve_AP := 0.0; END_IF;
        IF rTankLevel_AS < 0.15 THEN rAirSupplyValve_AS := 0.0; rDumpValve_AS := 0.0; END_IF;

        tonEmergencyBlowingTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#300S);

        IF (NOT bEmergencyDeBallastCmd AND bResetFaults) OR tonEmergencyBlowingTimer.Q THEN
            tonEmergencyBlowingTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 10;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_GRACEFUL_DEGRADATION: Decoupled Heuristic Trim with Single Sensor Disparity *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bAutoTrimActive := TRUE;
        bEmergencyBlowingActive := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;

        (* Reduced gain proportional attitude trim regulation (40% throttle clamp) *)
        IF rFilteredRoll > 0.75 THEN
            (* Starboard heel -> Blow Port tanks (FP, AP) and vent Starboard (FS, AS) *)
            rAirSupplyValve_FP := 35.0;  rDumpValve_FP := 40.0;  rVentValve_FP := 0.0;
            rAirSupplyValve_AP := 35.0;  rDumpValve_AP := 40.0;  rVentValve_AP := 0.0;
            rAirSupplyValve_FS := 0.0;   rDumpValve_FS := 25.0;  rVentValve_FS := 35.0;
            rAirSupplyValve_AS := 0.0;   rDumpValve_AS := 25.0;  rVentValve_AS := 35.0;
        ELSIF rFilteredRoll < -0.75 THEN
            (* Port heel -> Blow Starboard tanks (FS, AS) and vent Port (FP, AP) *)
            rAirSupplyValve_FS := 35.0;  rDumpValve_FS := 40.0;  rVentValve_FS := 0.0;
            rAirSupplyValve_AS := 35.0;  rDumpValve_AS := 40.0;  rVentValve_AS := 0.0;
            rAirSupplyValve_FP := 0.0;   rDumpValve_FP := 25.0;  rVentValve_FP := 35.0;
            rAirSupplyValve_AP := 0.0;   rDumpValve_AP := 25.0;  rVentValve_AP := 35.0;
        ELSE
            (* Stable attitude within deadband *)
            rAirSupplyValve_FP := 0.0;   rDumpValve_FP := 0.0;   rVentValve_FP := 0.0;
            rAirSupplyValve_FS := 0.0;   rDumpValve_FS := 0.0;   rVentValve_FS := 0.0;
            rAirSupplyValve_AP := 0.0;   rDumpValve_AP := 0.0;   rVentValve_AP := 0.0;
            rAirSupplyValve_AS := 0.0;   rDumpValve_AS := 0.0;   rVentValve_AS := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Transitions from Degraded State *)
        IF bEmergencyDeBallastCmd THEN
            iState := 40;
        ELSIF iMRU_FaultCount = 0 THEN
            iState := 20; (* Return to nominal MPC *)
        ELSIF iMRU_FaultCount >= 2 OR (rAirHeaderPressure < rAirHeaderMinPressure) THEN
            iState := 99; (* Trip to failsafe *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_FAILSAFE_LOCK: Critical Safety Interlock Tripped - Hydrostatic Isolation *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bAutoTrimActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyBlowingActive := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;

        (* Immediate hard isolation of all compressed air injection headers *)
        rAirSupplyValve_FP := 0.0;
        rAirSupplyValve_FS := 0.0;
        rAirSupplyValve_AP := 0.0;
        rAirSupplyValve_AS := 0.0;

        (* Immediate spring-return closure of seawater overboard dump valves *)
        rDumpValve_FP := 0.0;
        rDumpValve_FS := 0.0;
        rDumpValve_AP := 0.0;
        rDumpValve_AS := 0.0;

        (* Vent valves opened to atmospheric equalization to bleed trapped pneumatic pressure *)
        rVentValve_FP := 10.0;
        rVentValve_FS := 10.0;
        rVentValve_AP := 10.0;
        rVentValve_AS := 10.0;

        (* Manual reset latch release *)
        IF bResetFaults AND (rAirHeaderPressure >= rAirHeaderMinPressure) AND (iMRU_FaultCount < 2) AND
           (ABS(rFilteredRoll) < rMaxAllowableRoll) AND (ABS(rFilteredPitch) < rMaxAllowablePitch) THEN
            iState := 0; (* Reset to INIT *)
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        iState := 99; (* Unknown state failsafe catch-all *)
END_CASE;

IF tonAirSupplyStabilize.Q THEN wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0200; END_IF;
